summary: hashicorp.vault.kv2_secret_info reads KV2 secrets, replacing community.hashi_vault.vault_kv2_get. Parameters: engine_mount_point (default secret), required path (alias secret_path), optional version, and url (alias vault_address), plus vault_auth options.
questions: How do I read a specific version of a KV2 secret with hashicorp.vault?
